error_code.description: Stable strings. Clients treat an unknown code as internal.

mode.description: Permission mode the run starts in. The device's policy engine stays authoritative; the server uses the mode to decide which tools the model may see (plan mode: read-only tools plus plan_exit).

profile.description: O8: every run carries its profile. Further profiles (Menux's) are added to this list additively.

risk.description: R0 read-only, R1 write inside project, R2 run command, R3 network or outside project, R4 irreversible or external effect.

run_state.description: Run state machine: created -> running <-> awaiting_approval -> completed, plus paused_budget, paused_disconnected, paused_error, cancelled, failed, expired. Terminal: completed, cancelled, failed, expired.

tool_catalog_version.description: Which set of tool schemas the client can execute (protocol/v1/tools).

trust.description: Where a tool result came from, so the policy engine can taint the session.

envelope.description: Every message on the device socket. payload is validated against <t>.json. run_id: required on run-scoped messages, forbidden on hello/welcome/ping/pong, optional on error. seq: server stream events only (run_event, tool_proposed, budget_warning), strictly +1 per run.

fields.desc: Lower-case canonical UUID, minted by the sender of the message.
fields.name: id

fields.desc: Opaque run identifier. Minted by the client in run.start (a UUID or ULID is recommended); the server validates it, scopes it to the device's user, and rejects a collision with invalid_message. Never parse it.
fields.name: run_id

fields.desc: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset.
fields.name: ts

tools.description: Ask the person a question and wait for the answer. Use it when you are blocked on a decision that is theirs to make and cannot be settled from the request or the code. Offer up to six options when the answer is a choice; the person can also type their own words unless allow_free_text is false. The call blocks until they answer, decline or the timeout passes; do not ask the same thing again after a decline or a timeout.

fields.desc: The question, in plain words. At most 2000 characters.
fields.name: question

fields.desc: Choices to offer, at most six. Leave out for an open question.
Short single-line text the person picks; unique among the options.

tools.description: Keep a task list for the work in hand and show it to the person. Send the WHOLE list on every call: it replaces the previous one, and an empty list clears it.
